title: Hut-to-Hut Above Interlaken: Four Days Without Touching a Road
description: The Bernese Oberland has a trick the day-trippers never see: sleep in the mountain huts and the trails empty out by 4pm. Four days from Grindelwald to Kandersteg over three passes — how the hut booking system actually works, what half-board gets you (soup, so much soup), and the morning the Eiger came out of the clouds while we ate breakfast on a terrace at 2300 metres.

comments.comment: How far ahead did you book the huts? Trying to do this in August and half the sites are already showing full.
Five months out for the popular ones. But cancellations open up 2-3 days before if you can be flexible — that's how we got Blüemlisalphütte.
The soup thing is so accurate. Three courses and every single one is broth-adjacent. Would still go back tomorrow.
